title: fix(types): the data door answers the sandbox's own fault as a fault, not as an unknown object (#22868)
body:
Fixes #22868
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

The QuickJS runner raises some `SandboxError`s itself, with no `innerMessage`: a budget, a denied capability, an unavailable `ctx.api`, a missing `ctx.api` method, a failed install or marshal. Two of those texts name the object the hook body addressed:

- the `ctx.api.object(...)` capability gate (`quickjs-runner.ts:1173`, `throwSandboxFault`): `capability 'api.read' not granted to hook 'H' (called ctx.api.object('OBJ').find)`;
- the missing-method arm (`quickjs-runner.ts:1199`): `ctx.api.object('OBJ').find not implemented`.

`classifyDataError`'s unknown-object limb answers `404 OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` ("Object 'OBJ' is not registered") for a message holding the quoted requested object and `not`. So when the body addressed the request's own object, `mapDataError`, and every door that reaches it (`POST /api/v1/data/:object`, `resolveErrorResponse`'s fall-through, the import rows), answered a sandbox fault as "this object does not exist".

## The fix: one statement in `packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts`

`classifyDataError` asks `isSandboxOwnFault` (PR #22867) at its top, beside the `isSandboxCrash` terminal, and answers `UNCLASSIFIED_FAULT()`: `500`, `code: INTERNAL_ERROR`, `error: Internal server error`. No second rule: the predicate reads the producer's identity (`name === 'SandboxError'` and no `innerMessage`), never the text. The `isSandboxOwnFault` docblock's "mapDataError asks nothing here" paragraph now says that it does.

### Where it is asked, measured

`mapDataError(SandboxError(text), 'mz_locked')` on the source through `tsx`, with the fix line ablated (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored, blob == HEAD) and with the fix:

| runner text | fix ablated | with the fix |
|---|---|---|
| capability gate, requested object | 404 OBJECT_NOT_FOUND | 500 INTERNAL_ERROR |
| missing method, requested object | 404 OBJECT_NOT_FOUND | 500 INTERNAL_ERROR |
| capability gate, another object | 500 INTERNAL_ERROR | 500 INTERNAL_ERROR |
| capability gate, body-chosen object name `no such table` | 500 DATABASE_ERROR | 500 INTERNAL_ERROR |
| capability gate, body-chosen object name `unknown object` | 404 OBJECT_NOT_FOUND | 500 INTERNAL_ERROR |
| capability gate, body-chosen object name `has no column named x` | 400 INVALID_FIELD | 500 INTERNAL_ERROR |
| `ctx.title` gate, body-chosen field `unique constraint` | 500 DATABASE_ERROR | 500 INTERNAL_ERROR |
| `capability 'log' not granted to hook 'g'`, request object named `log` | 404 OBJECT_NOT_FOUND | 500 INTERNAL_ERROR |
| CPU budget | 500 INTERNAL_ERROR | 500 INTERNAL_ERROR |
| nested crash relayed as a fault (`hook 'g' threw: TypeError: boom`) | 500 INTERNAL_ERROR | 500 INTERNAL_ERROR |

The runner interpolates the body's own arguments (`ctx.api.object(name)`, `ctx.title(field)`) into its texts, so the missing-relation, `unknown object`, missing-column and leak limbs can each misread one too. An exclusion beside the substring limb alone would leave them. Asked at the top, the answer is the terminal the other runner faults already reached, so only misread answers move. Own faults carry no `code` or `status`, so the code-gated arms between the top and the message limbs never matched them.

## The pin: the producer enumeration, not the REST write-route ledger

The triage named the ledger #22764 rides (`packages/rest/src/rest-write-route-hook-refusal-sentence.ledger.test.ts`) as the family's enumeration. Measured, these two texts cannot live there inside this card:

- I added the two texts to its §6 `SANDBOX_FAULTS` on the fixed tree: **46 failed, 229 passed**. The 21 rows that answer through the classification passed. **23 hand-built rows** relay the runner's text verbatim: analytics dataset query, security explain, record shares (2), sharing rules (3), suggested bindings (2), approvals (9), package publish, external datasources (4). For example: `Received: "capability 'api.read' not granted to hook 'mz_guard' (called ctx.api.object('mz_locked').find)"`. Their `sandboxFaultAnswer` (`packages/rest/src/error-response.ts`) answers only for a sandbox ORIGIN (`innerMessage` set), so an own fault falls to each family's own terminal. That is a separate defect in `packages/rest`, outside this claim's file surface. It is reported for filing, not fixed here, and the probe was reverted.
- This member does fit in `packages/core/src/utils/import-runner-sandbox-fault-row.test.ts` (PR #22867). That file parses `quickjs-runner.ts` with the TypeScript compiler and renders every own-fault site. It holds each site to `mapDataError`'s `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` body and holds the import row to that sentence. Its sample object was deliberately NOT the import's object, and its header called this door defect out of scope. This PR makes the sample the requested object, so the two sites that name it are pinned at `500` from the producer. It also adds:
  - a census floor: at least one capability-denial site and one missing-method site name the requested object (no wording pinned);
  - CONTROL: a real SQLite or Postgres unknown-object text on the requested object still answers `404 OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`;
  - CONTROL: the same object-naming texts on a plain `Error` (not the sandbox) keep the heuristic's `404`, which proves the door asks the producer, not the words.

The `@objectstack/core` suite aliases `@objectstack/types` to its source (`packages/core/vitest.config.ts`), so this pin reads the fixed classification directly, with no `dist/` in between.

## Evidence, at HEAD `31b25500d1`

- Reverse verification, with the fix committed first (`d457a70fbd`): `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts --anchor "    if (isSandboxOwnFault(error)) return UNCLASSIFIED_FAULT();" --replacement "    /* ABLATED-22868 */" -- pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/utils/import-runner-sandbox-fault-row.test.ts`. The mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0). Result: **2 failed, 26 passed**, exactly `quickjs-runner.ts:1173 throwSandboxFault(…)` and `quickjs-runner.ts:1199 new SandboxError(…)`, both `expected 404 to be 500`. Every control and every other site stayed green. After the restore, blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. With the fix: 28 of 28.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/types test`: 27 files, 754 passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/types typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/utils/import-runner-sandbox-fault-row.test.ts src/utils/import-runner-sandbox-refusal-row.test.ts`: 2 files, 43 passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core typecheck`: exit 0. The test file is in `tsconfig.test.json`'s program (`--listFiles` count 1) and has no errors.
- `@objectstack/rest`, against the rebuilt `@objectstack/types` dist: 21 files that exercise the sandbox and unknown-object answers, 938 passed. They include `rest-unknown-object-heuristic`, `rest-hook-script-fault-envelope`, the unchanged write-route ledger and `rest.test.ts`.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths) derived 65. All 65 ran: 64 exit 0, and 1 NOT MEASURED. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs a whole-workspace build, and 44 packages had no `dist/`. Declared narrow substitute: `@objectstack/types`' CJS and ESM `dist` both load and answer the fixed `500`. `--ran` reconciliation: 65 accounted, 0 UNRUN.
- Lint, as a proven narrowing: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the two touched TS files reports 2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. There is no "file ignored" warning, so both files are in the config's `packages/**/*.{ts,…}` population. The config never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move a verdict in an untouched file. The `.md` changeset is outside eslint's population.

## Public surface

The one code line is a statement inside the non-exported `classifyDataError`. No declaration moved, so `@objectstack/types`' type surface is unchanged: the only non-comment changed line in `packages/types/src` is the new `if`. The runtime answer of `mapDataError` moves for an error named `SandboxError` with no `innerMessage`. Changeset: `@objectstack/types` `patch`.

## Acceptance notes

- The REST hand-built write routes that relay the runner's own-fault text (above) are reported to the dispatching seat for filing, with the probe. They are not addressed here.
